description: This file contains unit tests for the PsrHttpFactoryHelper class within the OrangeHRM OAuth service plugin. It verifies the creation and conversion of PSR-7 request and response objects from the application's HTTP request and response classes, including special handling for binary file responses.

classes.name: PsrHttpFactoryHelperTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the behavior of the PsrHttpFactoryHelper class functions, including request and response conversions, handling different HTTP methods, headers, and special response types.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Request
methods.description: Tests the creation of a PSR-7 request object from the application's Request class, for both GET and POST methods, including headers and body content.

methods.name: testCreatePsr7Response
methods.description: Tests the creation of a PSR-7 response object from the application's Response class, including headers, status code, body contents, and handling of BinaryFileResponse.

methods.name: testCreateRequestFromPsr7Request
methods.description: Verifies the conversion from a PSR-7 server request to the application's Request object, ensuring method, URI, query parameters, and attributes are correctly mapped.

methods.name: testCreateResponseFromPsr7Response
methods.description: Ensures the conversion from a PSR-7 response to the application's Response object preserves status code and headers.
